title: HostEventRequestViewDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of everyone waiting on one coming event: join requests and the offerable waitlist in order, with the rows listOrganizerRequests returns. Written by triggers on the event, its waitlisted participations, the people's public profiles and the organizer's contact summaries. An event with nobody waiting, an event that is not active and an event that has ended have no view. Rows are not filtered by blocks; readers hide anyone with a block either way with them. row.offerExpiresAtMillis is an active offer's expiry even after it passes, so readers compare it with their clock. Never identity, permission or mutation authority.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels request view triggers)

eventEndMillis.description: When the event ends. Readers list views whose event has not ended yet.

rows.description: Oldest ask first. Requests have no waitlist position; waitlist rows are numbered among the people the host can offer a spot.

complete.description: False when more people wait on this event than the view holds.
